inputs: rules/common/orchestration-patterns (Windows has no native OS-level process sandbox)
question_or_target: Define and enforce what a shipped script may do: which executables it may spawn, whether it may reach the network, which directories it may write, and what happens when it exceeds the policy. Sets the security posture for third-party-authored content and therefore requires owner sign-off.
tests_required: tools/plugin/tests/test_exec_policy.py (forbidden spawn, forbidden write, forbidden network)
NEGATIVE CONTROL: an allowed script performs the same class of action successfully in the same run
HONESTY CASE: assert the documented limitation matches the tested containment (no overclaim of sandboxing)
title: Execution policy for plugin-shipped scripts
